A '''Phantomleaf''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Mutation]].

== Obtaining ==
A '''Phantomleaf''' can grow in the [[Greenhouse]] if there are {{Item|Chorus Fruit|amount=4}} and {{Item|Shellfruit|amount=4}} within {{Green|1}} block of {{Item|Soul Sand}}.

While growing, a '''Phantomleaf''' does not need water and has {{Green|15}} {{Dark Green|Growth Stages}}. When placed near another crop, it grants immunity to negative effects and increases {{Skill|Farming}} experience by {{Green|20%}}.

When harvested, a '''Phantomleaf''' hides in a random crop in the [[Greenhouse]] for {{Green|60}} seconds. While hiding, a heart icon and heartbeat appear to aid in finding it. Clicking on the correct crop harvests the '''Phantomleaf'''. If the player clicks on the incorrect crop or time runs out, the '''Phantomleaf''' is destroyed.

If there are no other crops in the [[Greenhouse]], then the '''Phantomleaf''' will not hide, the minigame will not begin, and it will neither be harvested nor broken.

== Crop Drops ==
When harvested, '''Phantomleafs''' also drop {{Item|Potato|amount=3000}}, {{Item|Carrot|amount=3500}}, and {{Skill XP|8000 Farming}}.

== Usage ==
=== Crop Analyzer ===
A '''Phantomleaf''' can be analyzed in the [[Crop Analyzer]] for {{c|3m}}. When analyzed, it grants {{Copper|1500}}. The first time analyzing a '''Phantomleaf''' grants an additional {{Copper|1500}}.

=== NPC Trading ===
{{Item|Phantomleaf|amount=1}} is needed to purchase a {{Item|Rose Dragon Egg}} from {{NPCSprite|Ludleth}}.
